title: What if you were stranded on a frozen mountain with an influencer?
formula: Contradiction hook (escaping the cold inside ice, mocked as a freezer) -> why (crash, forty below, a week to rescue) -> rival with the 'perfect' version (heated tent, live stream) -> weird prep with measured progress (hour stamps, roof hole, sunken door) -> the mocker's comfort vs yours -> blizzard setback for him -> status flip at ~80% -> hidden plan explained mid-storm -> knock -> loop: room in the freezer
loop: Line 1: the only other survivor calls your ice house a freezer. Last: he asks, very quietly, if there's room in the freezer (same word, the mocker now begging).
facts: Snow is mostly trapped air and insulates well; an igloo warmed by body heat alone can sit between about -7 C and +16 C inside while it is far colder outside (Wikipedia 'Igloo'; verify wording before voice). 'Almost forty degrees warmer' is within that range against -40 outside.
Igloos have a small vent hole in the roof, and a sunken entrance (a cold trap) because cold air sinks and stays below the sleeping level (Wikipedia 'Igloo'; verify before voice).
Forty below is the same in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
Tent poles snapping in a long blizzard and a battery heater dying: scenario logic, exaggerated for comedy.

lines.narration: You're building a house out of ice, and the only other survivor calls it a *freezer*.
lines.scene: Cold open, white mountain ridge at golden hour: you in your rust jacket, sliding a snow block onto a half-built dome. Ten metres away, a glowing orange high-tech tent; Brock points his phone at you, laughing.
lines.camera: Low angle push-in past the half dome to you, rack focus to Brock
lines.gag: Brock's phone has a ring light clipped to it

lines.narration: Because your plane is stuck on a mountain, it's forty below, and rescue is a week *away*.
lines.scene: Pull back over the ridge: a small plane nose-down in a snowdrift, unharmed but stuck, its propeller bent like a pretzel; endless peaks, no roads.
lines.camera: Fast pull-out with motion-blur streaks to an extreme wide
lines.gag: The bent propeller slowly droops

lines.narration: The other survivor is Brock. He has a $3,000 heated tent, and he's live *streaming*.
lines.spoken: The other survivor is Brock. He has a three-thousand-dollar heated tent, and he's live streaming.
lines.scene: Brock: puffy neon jacket, frosted tips, sunglasses on his head, phone on a selfie stick. His tent glows orange, a battery heater humming inside, a sign on the flap: 'BROCK HQ'.
lines.camera: Glide around the tent to Brock posing
lines.gag: The tent has a doormat that says 'BROCK HQ'

lines.narration: "Bro's building a freezer," he tells 40,000 followers, and they *love* it.
lines.spoken: "Bro's building a freezer," he tells forty thousand followers, and they love it.
lines.scene: Phone screen POV: Brock's selfie with you small in the background; laughing emojis flood up the screen; a live counter reads 40,000.
lines.camera: Push into the phone screen
lines.gag: Laughing emojis flood the stream

lines.narration: But you keep cutting snow blocks. Hour 1, ten. Hour 3, forty. By sunset, a *dome*.
lines.spoken: But you keep cutting snow blocks. Hour one, ten. Hour three, forty. By sunset, a dome.
lines.scene: Three dissolves on the same framing as the sun drops: a ring of ten blocks, a waist-high spiral, a finished dome glowing pink in the dusk.
lines.camera: Locked framing with a slow creep-in across three dissolves
lines.gag: Each dissolve, Brock in the background has a new snack

lines.narration: Then it gets weirder. You poke a hole in the roof, on *purpose*.
lines.scene: You on top of the dome jabbing a stick through the roof; a little puff of snow pops out.
lines.camera: Low angle on you against the dusk sky
lines.gag: The puff of snow lands on Brock's sunglasses

lines.narration: And you dig the door lower than the floor, like a little *ditch*.
lines.scene: Cross-section cut-away of the igloo: the sleeping shelf high inside, the tunnel entrance dug down below it like a ditch.
lines.camera: Side-on cut-away, slow push along the tunnel
lines.gag: You slide down the ditch on your belly like a penguin

lines.narration: Brock zooms in. "Now his freezer has a *basement*."
lines.scene: Phone POV zooming on your boots disappearing into the tunnel; more laughing emojis.
lines.camera: Fast digital zoom inside the phone frame
lines.gag: The chat spams 'BASEMENT' with skull emojis

lines.narration: That night, Brock sleeps in his *shorts*.
lines.scene: Night, deep blue snow under stars: Brock's tent glows warm orange; through the fabric, his silhouette in shorts, fanning himself.
lines.camera: Slow push toward the glowing tent
lines.gag: His silhouette is fanning himself

lines.narration: You sleep in your jacket, next to one tiny *candle*.
lines.scene: Inside the dome: blue ice walls, you curled up on the shelf in your jacket, one candle flame making the walls glow gold.
lines.camera: Slow pull-out from the candle flame to you
lines.gag: Your breath makes little clouds

lines.narration: Then, on day 3, a blizzard hits, and it doesn't *stop*.
lines.spoken: [tense] Then, on day three, a blizzard hits, and it doesn't stop.
lines.scene: White-out: snow blasting sideways across the ridge, the plane half buried, the two shelters barely visible.
lines.camera: Wide, camera rocked by gusts, impact kicks on each gust
lines.gag: The plane's bent propeller spins the wrong way in the wind

lines.narration: The wind howls for two days. His tent poles bend, then snap. One. Two. *Three*.
lines.scene: Brock's tent bowing in the wind; one pole snaps, then another, then a third, the glow flickering.
lines.camera: Hard cuts closer on each snap
lines.gag: Each snap makes Brock's frosted tips stand straight up

lines.narration: His heater dies, and his fancy tent wraps around him like a *burrito*.
lines.scene: The tent goes dark and collapses onto Brock, folding around him until only his face sticks out of a fabric roll.
lines.camera: Tilt down with the collapsing tent, push-in on his face
lines.gag: Brock rolled up in his tent like a burrito, sunglasses still on his head

lines.narration: Meanwhile, inside your house of ice, you just took off your *jacket*.
lines.scene: Inside the igloo: calm, golden candlelight, you in your striped tee sipping melted snow from a mug, jacket folded beside you. Muffled storm outside.
lines.camera: Slow arc around you
lines.gag: You're reading the plane's safety card like a magazine

lines.narration: You see, snow is mostly trapped air, and trapped air works like a giant puffy *blanket*.
lines.scene: Macro on a snow block: a glowing cut-away shows tiny air pockets between the crystals, like a sponge.
lines.camera: Macro push into the snow block
lines.gag: The air pockets are drawn as tiny sleeping faces

lines.narration: The roof hole lets old air out, and the ditch traps the cold, because cold air *sinks*.
lines.scene: Cross-section again: a soft warm-orange glow fills the dome and drifts out of the roof hole; blue cold air pours into the ditch and pools there like water.
lines.camera: Side-on cut-away, tilt from the roof hole down to the ditch
lines.gag: The cold air pools in the ditch like a blue puddle

lines.narration: So one candle and your body heat make it almost forty degrees warmer in *here*.
lines.scene: Split by the ice wall: inside golden and calm, outside white and screaming; a little thermometer on each side.
lines.camera: Slow lateral glide through the wall from inside to outside
lines.gag: The outside thermometer is frozen solid

lines.narration: Then, something knocks on your *wall*.
lines.spoken: [tense, hushed] Then, something knocks on your wall.
lines.scene: Inside: three soft thumps; snow dust falls from the ceiling; you freeze mid-sip.
lines.camera: Punch close-up on you, hard cut
lines.gag: Snow dust sprinkles into your mug

lines.narration: It's Brock, still in the burrito, phone at 1%. His chat is one word, over and *over*.
lines.spoken: It's Brock, still in the burrito, phone at one percent. His chat is one word, over and over.
lines.scene: POV from inside the tunnel: Brock's face at the entrance, rolled in his tent, ice in his eyebrows, phone held up. On the screen the chat scrolls: 'FREEZER FREEZER FREEZER'.
lines.camera: POV from the tunnel, push into the phone screen
lines.gag: The chat scrolls 'FREEZER' forever

lines.narration: He asks, very quietly, if there's room in the *freezer*.
lines.spoken: [deadpan] He asks, very quietly, if there's room in the freezer.
lines.scene: Close-up on Brock: chattering teeth, icicle on his nose, puppy eyes. Same framing as the cold open's laugh, now begging. Behind him, the storm.
lines.camera: Push-in on Brock's face, end on the word
lines.gag: An icicle hangs off Brock's nose
